title: GPT Image joins the image model list
summary:
GPT Image joined the model list, six community projects joined the showcase, and the text cache learned to keep better notes.

Added `gptimage` with JPEG output and a 1024-pixel maximum side length. Failed requests now return clearer errors instead of silently falling back to another model.

The project list gained an AI YouTube Shorts generator, Favorite Puzzles, and The Promised Pen, a novel-writing app that can draft and rewrite using story context.

Three more projects joined the showcase: FoldaScan for asking questions about a codebase, Pollin-Coder for building website layouts and content from a description, and PolliBot for image and text generation through Telegram.

highlights.title: GPT Image added
highlights.text: Generate JPEG images with `gptimage`, with a maximum side length of 1024 pixels. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gptimage).
